limitations: Same 30 selected reads as prior analysis; no additional independent support
Single-read BWA candidates enumerated as pairs, not paired realignment or calibrated fragment likelihood
500/1000/2000bp are explicit descriptive sensitivity bounds, not new acceptance criteria or estimated library distribution
Panel consists of reported alternatives, not exhaustive whole-genome competitive mapping
AS sums are alignment scores, not posterior probabilities or genotypes; mates grouped by name do not prove molecule independence
